title: BANJUL PROTOCOL ON MARKS WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF THE AFRICAN REGIONAL INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ORGANIZATION (ARIPO) (1993)
pdf_name: Protocol on marks within the framework of the ARIPO

articles.heading: Isuzuma ryimbitse rikozwe n'igihugu cyagenwe 6:1 Buri busabe bujyanye no kwandikisha ikirango cy'ubucuruzi bugomba
articles.text:
gusuzumwa hakurikijwe amategeko
y’igihugu cyagenwe.
6:2 Mbere y’uko amezi 9 arangira uhereye
ku itariki yatangiweho imenyesha
rivugwaho mu Cyiciro cya 5:3, buri gihugu
cyagenwe gishobora kumenyesha Ibiro mu
nyandiko ko, ikirango cy'ubucuruzi
cyandikishijwe ku Biro, uko
kwandikishwa kutazagira agaciro ku
butaka bwacyo hashingiwe ku mpamvu
izo ari zo zose, zaba impamvu zihagije
cyangwa izishingira ku kindi kintu, harimo
kubahiriza uburenganzira bw'abandi batari
mu masezerano.
6:3 Mu gihe Igihugu cyagenwe cyanze
kwakira ubusabe hashingiwe ku Cyiciro
cya 6:2, kigomba gutanga impamvu
hashingiwe ku mategeko yacyo zatumye
cyanga kwakira ubwo busabe. Izo mpamvu
zigomba, mu gihe cy'ukwezi kumwe
icyemezo gifashwe, kumenyeshwa Ibiro
na byo bikabimenyesha usaba bidatinze.
6:4 Usaba agomba guhabwa amahirwe yo
gusubiza Igihugu cyagenwe kirebwa
yifashishije Ibiro, ku bijyanye n'icyemezo
cyafashe cyo kwanga kwakira ubusabe.
Icyemezo kirajuririrwa cyangwa kikongera
gusuzumwa hashingiwe ku mategeko y’
Igihugu cyagenwe kirebwa. Ubujurire
cyangwa kongera gusuzumwa bisabwa
hifashishijwe Ibiro. Igihugu cyagenwe
kigomba kumenyesha Ibiro icyemezo
cy'ubujurire cyangwa cyafashwe nyuma
y’uko hongeye kubaho isuzuma, mu gihe
cy'ukwezi kumwe uhereye ku itariki
cyatangarijwe.
6:5 Kumenyesha Ibiro nk'uko biteganyijwe
mu Cyiciro cya 6:2 cyangwa kwanga
kwakira ubusabe bikozwe n'Igihugu
cyagenwe ntibigomba gufatwa nk'ibibuza
Ibiro gutanga icyemezo cy'uko ikirango
cy'ubucuruzi cyanditswe kigomba
kubahirizwa muri ibyo Bihugu byagenwe
bitamenyekanishije ubusabe nk'uko
biteganyijwe mu Cyiciro cya 6:2 cyangwa
ngo byange kubwakira.
6:6 Mu gihe Igihugu cyagenwe
cyamenyekanishije ubusabe nk'uko
biteganyijwe mu cyiciro cya 6:2 nyuma
kikisubiraho cyangwa mu gihe Igihugu
cyagenwe cyabanje kwanga kwakira
ubusabe ariko nyuma kikisubiraho, icyo
Gihugu cyagenwe kigomba kubimenyesha
Ibiro, mu gihe cy'ukwezi kumwe. Iyo
bimeze bityo, ibiro bigomba kongera icyo
Gihugu cyagenwe mu bigomba kubahiriza
iyandikishwa.
Icyiciro cya 6bis: Gutangaza,
Kwandikisha no kumenyesha
itambamira
6bis:1 (a) Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
ikirango cy'ubucuruzi bwemewe n'Igihugu
icyo ari cyo cyose cyagenwe cyangwa
kitamenyekanishije nk'uko bivugwa mu
Cyiciro cya 6:2 bugomba gutangazwa mu
Kinyamakuru cy'Ibirango by'ubucuruzi
nk'ubwemewe cyangwa mu gihe nta
Gihugu cyagenwe cyakoze imenyekanisha,
ikirango cy'ubucuruzi gitangazwa
nk'icyemewe by'agateganyo n'icyo Gihugu
cyagenwe cyangwa n'Ibihugu byagenwe
birebwa.
(b) Mu gihe Ibihugu byose byagenwe
bimenyekanishije ko byemeye ubusabe
mbere y'igihe cy'amezi icyenda kivugwa
mu Cyiciro cya 6:2, Usaba ashobora
gusaba ko hatangazwa ubwo busabe hakiri
kare hamaze kwishyurwa amafaranga
ateganyijwe.
(c) Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango
cy'ubucuruzi butakiriwe n'Ibiro nk'uko
biteganyijwe mu Cyiciro cya 5:2 cyangwa,
n'Igihugu cyagenwe kirebwa nk'uko
biteganyijwe mu Cyiciro cya 6:3 bugomba
gutangazwa mu Gitabo cy'Ibirango
by'ubucuruzi nk'ubutarakiriwe cyangwa
nk'ubuzakirwa hamaze kuzuzwa ibisabwa,
n'Ibiro cyangwa Igihugu cyagenwe
cyangwa n'Ibihugu byagenwe birebwa.
6bis:2 Hashingiwe ku biteganywa mu
cyiciro cya 6bis:4, amezi atatu nyuma
y'itanganzwa ryo mu Kinyamakuru nk'uko
bivugwa mu Cyiciro cya 6bis:1, Ibiro
bigomba kwandika ikirango cy'ubucuruzi
hamaze kwishyurwa amafaranga yo
kwandikisha. Iryo yandikisha rikorerwa
mu Gitabo cy'ibirango by'ubucuruzi ndetse
n'Ibiro bigaha usaba icyemezo cy'uko
ikirango cy'ubucuruzi cyanditswe.
6bis:3 Igikorwa cyo kwandika ikirango
cy'ubucuruzi kigomba gutangazwa mu
Kinyamakuru.
6bis:4 Igihe icyo ari cyo cyose ubusabe
butangajwe mu Kinyamakuru cy'Ibirango
by'ubucuruzi nk'ubwemewe n'Igihugu
cyagenwe cyangwa n'Ibihugu byagenwe
hakurikijwe Icyiciro cya 6bis:1, ariko
mbere y'iyandikwa ry'ikirango
cy'ubucuruzi hakurikijwe 6bis:2, umuntu
uwo ari we wese ubyifuza ashobora
kumenyesha itambamira ry'ubusabe bwo
kwandikisha; iryo menyesha rigomba
gushyikirizwa Ibiro. Nyuma yo
kubutambamira, ubusabe bugomba
kwigwaho hagendewe ku buryo
bwashyizweho bwo kwiga niba ubusabe
bushobora gutambamirwa hashingiwe ku
mategeko y’Igihugu cyagenwe cyangwa
ibihugu byagenwe birebwa.
6bis:5 Mu gihe usaba ananiwe kwishyura
amafaranga yo kwandikisha mu gihe
cyamezi 12, nyuma y’uko ubusabe
bwemewe bukanatangazwa nk'uko
bivugwa mu Cyiciro cya 6bis:2, ubusabe
bugomba gufatwa nk'ubwakuwemo.
Icyiciro cya 7: Igihe, kongera igihe
n'isubizwaho by'iyandikisha
7:1 Iyandikisha ry'ikirango cy'ubucuruzi
rigomba kumara igihe cy'imyaka 10
uhereye ku itariki ryasabiweho.
7:2 Iyandikisha ry'ikirango cy'ubucuruzi
rishobora kongererwa ikindi gihe
cy'imyaka 10 hishyuwe amafaranga
yateganyijwe kugira ngo habeho
iyongerwa ry'igihe.
7:3 Kongerera igihe iyandikisha bigomba
gukorwa ku itariki iyandikisha rya mbere
rirangiriraho cyangwa mbere yayo
cyangwa se mbere y'itariki iyandikisha
ryongerewe bwa nyuma rirangiriraho
hashingiwe ko hagomba gutangwa igihe
kitabarwa cy'amezi atandatu, hishyuwe
amafaranga yiyongera ku yateganyijwe
buri gihe uko habayeho iyongerwa ry'igihe.
7:4 Iyandikisha ry'ikirango ritongerewe
igihe bitewe no kutishyura amafaranga yo
kongera igihe mu gihe giteganyijwe mu
Cyiciro cya 7:3, rigomba gufatwa
nk'iritakiriho kandi rigakurwa mu Gitabo
cy'Ibirango by'ubucuruzi.
7:5 Ikirango cyakuwe mu gitabo kubera
kutishyura amafaranga yo kongera igihe
gishobora gusubizwamo bisabwe na
nyir’ubwite hishyuwe amafaranga
yateganyijwe kugira ngo habeho
isubizwaho ry'iyandikisha mu gihe
cyateganyijwe.
Icyiciro cya 8: Ingaruka z'iyandikisha
8:1 Iyandikisha ry'ikirango cy'ubucuruzi
rigomba kugira ingaruka zimwe muri buri
Gihugu cyagenwe, ku bijyanye
n'uburenganzira bugenerwa ikirango
cy'ubucuruzi, nk’aho ryasabwe kandi
rikandikishwa hashingiwe ku mategeko ya
buri Gihugu.
8:2 Amategeko ya buri Gihugu kiri mu
Masezerano agomba gukurikizwa ku
iseswa ry'iyandikisha, ryaba rishingiye ku
kuba ridakoreshwa cyangwa indi mpamvu
iyo ari yo yose. Mu gihe iyandikisha
ryaseshwe, Igihugu kiri mu Masezerano
kirebwa, kigomba, mu gihe cy'ukwezi
kumwe habayeho iseswa, kubimenyesha
Ibiro. Ibiro bigomba gutangaza icyo
gikorwa mu Kinyamakuru cy'Ibirango
by'ubucuruzi ndetse kikanabyandika mu
Gitabo cy'ibirango by'ubucuruzi.
8.3 Kwerekana ibyiciro by'ibicuruzwa
cyangwa bya serivisi byagaragajwe ntibiba
itegeko ku Bihugu biri mu Masezerano ku
birebana no kugaragaza imbibi zo
kurengerwa kwagenewe ikirango
cy'ubucuruzi.
Icyikiro cya 9: Kugena ibindi bihugu
nyuma y'iyandikisha
9:1 Mu gihe ikirango cy'ubucuruzi
cyanditswe n'Ibiro cyangwa gitegereje
kwandikwa n'Ibiro, nyiracyo cyangwa
usaba cyangwa aho bishoboka,
umusimbura we ubyemerewe, bafite
uburenganzira bwo kugena ikindi gihugu
icyo ari cyo cyose kiri mu Masezerano
nyuma y'iyandikisha cyangwa ubwo
gutanga ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
ikirango cy'ubucuruzi.
9:2 Mu gihe, hashingiwe ku cyiciro cya
9:1, nyir'ikirango cy'ubucuruzi
cyandikishijwe cyangwa usaba
kwandikisha ikirango cy'ubucuruzi
agennye nyuma yaho ikindi Gihugu icyo
ari cyo cyose, uko kugena Igihugu gufatwa
nko gusaba kwandikisha ikirango
cy'ubucuruzi muri icyo Gihugu cyagenwe
muri ubwo buryo kandi bikaba bigomba
gusuzumwa hashingiwe ku mategeko y’
icyo Gihugu cyagenwe nk'uko
biteganyijwe mu Cyiciro cya 6
cy'Amasezerano y'Inyongera. Iyo bimeze
bityo, itariki yatangiweho ubusabe bwa
mbere ifatwa nk'itariki yatangiweho
ubusabe mu Gihugu cyagenwe muri ubwo
buryo. Itariki y'ubusabe bwo kongera
ikindi gihugu mu byagenwe, iyo bwujuje
ibisabwa kubahirizwa, ifatwa nk'itariki
Ibiro byabwakiriyeho. Itariki y'ubusabe
bwo kongera ikindi gihugu mu byagenwe
igomba kwandikwa mu Gitabo cy'ibirango
by'ubucuruzi kandi ikanatangazwa mu
Kinyamakuru cya ARIPO.
9:3 Igihe cyo kurengerwa hashingiwe ko
hongerewe ikindi gihugu mu byagenwe
nyuma y'iyandikisha, kirangira ku itariki
imwe n'irangiriraho iyandikisha rya mbere.
Icyiciro cya 10: Amabwiriza
Inama y’Ubutegetsi ishyiraho amabwiriza
mu rwego rwo gushyira mu bikorwa aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera kandi ishobora
kuyavugurura iyo bikenewe.
10:2 Bitabangamiye icyo Akiciro ka 1
k'Icyiciro cya 10 kagamije, Amabwiriza
agomba:
(a) guteganya ibisabwa n'ubuyobozi
cyangwa ibisobanuro ibyo ari byo byose
bikenewe mu rwego rwo gushyira mu
bikorwa ibiteganywa n'aya Masezerano
y'Inyongera ndetse n'andi Masezerano
mpuzamahanga ayo ari yo yose bijyanye;
(b) guteganya umubare w'amafaranga
agomba kwishyuzwa n'Ibiro hamwe
n'ibisobanuro by'uko igice cy'ayo
mafaranga kigabagabanywa Ibihugu biri
mu Masezerano; no
(c) guteganya umugereka uriho ifishi
ikoreshwa mu bijyanye n'iyandikisha.
10:3 Mu gihe usaba ananiwe kubahiriza
igihe ntarengwa kigaragara mu
Masezerano y'Inyongera, mu Mabwiriza
cyangwa mu Mabwiriza atangwa
n'ubuyobozi ndetse n'iyo uwo usaba
ananiwe gusaba ko icyo gihe cyongerwa
mu rwego rwo kubahiriza icyo gihe
ntarengwa, ubusabe cyangwa iyandikisha
bifatwa nk'ibitakiriho mu kwezi kumwe
uhereye ku itariki icyo gihe ntarengwa
cyarangiriyeho, hatitawe ko ubusabe
cyangwa iyandikisha bigifite agaciro.
Icyiciro 11: Gutangira gukurikizwa
11:1 Igihugu icyo ari cyose kiri mu bigize
ARIPO cyangwa Igihugu icyo ari cyo
cyose cyemerewe kuba kimwe mu bigize
ARIPO gishobora kuba muri aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera binyuze mu :
(i) gushyiraho umukono ukurikirwa no
gutanga inyandiko yo kuyemeza burundu;
cyangwa
(ii) gutanga inyandiko yemera kuba kimwe
mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera.
11:2 Inyandiko ziyemeza burundu
n'inyandiko zemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera zishyikirizwa Umuyobozi
Mukuru wa ARIPO.
11:3 Aya Masezerano y'Inyongera atangira
gukurikizwa mu mezi atatu nyuma y’uko
ibihugu bitatu bitanze inyandiko ziyemeza
burundu cyangwa inyandiko zemera kuba
kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera.
11:4 Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kitari mu
biri muri aya Masezerano y'Inyongera mu
gihe atangiye gukurikizwa, gitangira
kuyakurikiza nyuma y'amezi atatu uhereye
ku itariki cyatangiyeho inyandiko iyemeza
burundu cyangwa isaba kuba kimwe mu
bihugu biyahuriyeho.
11:5 Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose cyemeje
burundu aya Masezerano y'Inyongera
cyangwa cyemeye kuba kimwe mu bihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y'Inyongera
gitanze inyandiko yo kuyemeza burundu
cyangwa yo kwemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu biyahuriyeho, gifatwa
nk'icyagaragaje ko cyemera gukurikiza
n'ibiteganywa mu Masezerano ashyiraho
Umuryango Nyafurika ugamije kurengera
Umutungo Bwite mu by'Ubwenge
(ARIPO) kandi icyo gihugu kiba ikigize
Umuryango ARIPO ku itariki
cyatangiyeho inyandiko yemeza burundu
aya Masezerano y’Inyongera cyangwa
yemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano y'Inyongera.
Icyiciro cya 12: Kwivana mu
Masezerano y'Inyongera
12:1 Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri
aya Masezerano y'Inyongera gishobora
kuyivanamo gikoresheje imenyesha
gishyikiriza Umuyobozi Mukuru wa
ARIPO.
12:2 Kwivana muri aya Masezerano
y'Inyongera bitangira gukurikizwa nyuma
y'amezi atandatu uhereye igihe Umuyobozi
Mukuru wa ARIPO yabimenyesherejwe
kandi ntibibangamira ubusabe bwatanzwe
cyangwa iyandikisha ry'ikirango
cy'ubucuruzi ryabaye kubera ubwo busabe,
mbere y’uko ayo mezi atandatu arangira.
Icyiciro 13: Ivugururwa
ry'Amasezerano y'Inyongera
13:1 Aya Masezerano y'Inyongera
ashobora kuvugururwa bisabwe n'Igihugu
icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyangwa n’Umuyobozi
Mukuru wa ARIPO, mu nteko z’Inama
y’Ubutegetsi.
13:2 Kwemeza amavugururwa y’ingingo
iyo ari yo yose y'aya Masezerano
y'Inyongera bisaba kwemezwa ku
bwiganze bwa bibiri bya gatatu by'amajwi
y'ibihugu byose biri mu Masezerano.
Icyiciro cya 14: Gushyira umukono ku
Masezerano y'Inyongera
14:1 Aya Masezerano y'Inyongera
ashyirwaho umukono kuri kopi imwe
rukumbi kandi agashyikirizwa Umuyobozi
Mukuru wa ARIPO.
14:2 Umuyobozi Mukuru wa ARIPO
yoherereza kopi z'aya Masezerano
y'Inyongera, zihuje n’umwimerere Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y’Inyongera,
ibindi Bihugu bigize Umuryango ARIPO
n'ibihugu byemerewe kuba bimwe mu
bigize ARIPO hakurikijwe ingingo ya IV
y'Amasezerano ashyiraho Umuryango
Nyafurika ugamije kurengera Umutungo
Bwite mu by'Ubwenge (ARIPO).
